entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Talented, arrogant young wizard from Tolaria, mage of the Weatherlight, later Crovax's lapdog and resurrected Phyrexian.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship Ertai served on as mage.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Ertai's home academy.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane where Ertai was abandoned.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Weatherlight captain who was kidnapped.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who challenged by Ertai.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Master who provided Ertai as his apprentice.

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: Soltari who aided Ertai's ritual.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Ship that attacked the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Captured Ertai and took him to the Stronghold.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: Ertai's romantic partner, killed by Eladamri.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Became evincar of Rath.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Evincar defeated by Crovax.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Killed Belbe and fled to Dominaria.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Weatherlight leader captured by Ertai.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Immortal goblin whom Ertai repeatedly killed.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian who reconstituted Ertai.

entities.name: Dominaria United
entities.description: The second Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: Karn

entities.name: Aron Capashen
entities.description: Compleated by Ertai.

events.summary: Barrin provides Ertai as the Weatherlight's mage; Ertai defeats Hanna in a contest.
events.quote: Ertai challenged Hanna to a competition which he won easily.

events.summary: On Rath, Ertai opens a portal with Lyna's help but is left behind as the Weatherlight flees Predator.
events.quote: the Weatherlight was being hotly pursued by Predator as it fled, and so was forced to leave Ertai behind.

events.summary: Greven il-Vec captures Ertai and takes him to the Stronghold.
events.quote: Ertai was captured by Greven il -Vec and taken back to the Stronghold

events.summary: Ertai secretly helps Crovax win the duel against Volrath.
events.quote: he used his magic to off-balance Volrath at a critical moment and thus give Crovax the victory

events.summary: Eladamri kills Belbe and flees to Dominaria, leaving Ertai to submit to Crovax.
Ertai captures Gerrard and Squee and teleports them to the Stronghold.
events.quote: where he captured Gerrard (and, accidentally, Squee ) and teleported them into the Stronghold

events.summary: Squee overloads a Phyrexian healing device, killing Ertai in the explosion.
Centuries later Sheoldred reconstitutes Ertai, who takes control of the new academy at Lat-Nam.
events.quote: Ertai was reconstituted by the dark sciences of Sheoldred

events.summary: Ertai compleats Aron Capashen and Squee's goblin clan.
events.quote: He compleated Aron Capashen and Squee's clan of goblins

events.summary: At the Battle of the Mana Rig Ertai leads an attack on Karn and is last seen stumbling over the edge before its self-destruction.
events.quote: He was last seen stumbling over the edge of the Rig before its self-destruction.

relations.quote: was thus transformed into Crovax's loyal lapdog
largely because of his romantic relationship with Belbe

relations.note: Regarded Gerrard and company as personal enemies.
